about.title: About Connect/ED
about.tagline: Your school. Your ideas. Your network.
about.whatText: Connect/ED is a platform developed by students that lets schools organise joint events, ideas and projects. Students should be able to take the initiative themselves and connect with other schools.
about.originText: The idea came from a group of students at Ernst-Reuter-Schule Ankara. An earlier design prototype for German lessons turned into a platform for cross-school collaboration.

about.works2: Interface in German, Turkish and English

help.title: Help & FAQ
help.subtitle: Short answers to common questions
help.intro: Learn how Connect/ED works. Tap a question to open the answer.
help.more: Your question is not here? You can find more about the project under “About Connect/ED”.

what.a: A student-made platform for collaboration between schools – started at Ernst-Reuter-Schule Ankara. You can find joint events, share project ideas and talk to each other.

how.q: How do I use the platform?
how.a: “Home” shows your next events and suggestions. “Discover” contains events and ideas. “Tutoring” is a separate area where you can offer or look for tutoring. “Community” contains student profiles, project and event groups, and games. For messages there is a separate “Chatroom” area. Without signing in you can see the home page, the games, the help and “About Connect/ED”.

profile.q: How do I update my profile?
profile.a: In “My Area” you choose your interests, set the language and decide under “Profile sharing” what others can see. You enter your first name, school and grade when you register; you cannot change them in the app yet.

join.q: How can I join a chatroom?
join.a: Open the chat and tap “Join” on a topic room. The chat only works when you are signed in and it is switched on for the platform.

enter.q: How do I enter a room and send messages?
enter.a: As a member, tap “Enter room”. Type your message at the bottom and tap “Send” (or press Enter). New messages appear automatically.

leave.q: How can I leave a chatroom?
leave.a: Tap “Leave” in the overview or inside the room. After that you cannot read the messages until you join again. Project and event groups belong to the project team or the event registration and cannot be left separately.

private.a: On a shared profile you can send a message request. A private chat only starts when the other person accepts. You do not have to answer requests, and you can also block or report people.

discover.a: Under “Discover” → “Events” there are “For me” (matching your interests), “All” and “Mine”. Your next events are also shown on the home page.

register.q: How can I register for an event?
register.a: Open the event and tap “Join”. With “Show interest” you bookmark it without committing. If an event is full or has already started, registration is no longer possible.

cancel.q: How can I cancel my registration?
cancel.a: Open the event and tap “Cancel sign-up”.

cancelled.q: What happens when an event is cancelled?
cancelled.a: The event is marked as “cancelled” and does not take place. You do not need to do anything.

manage.q: How can I manage my profile?
manage.a: In “My Area” you find your interests, your activity and profile sharing. Only you can see your activity numbers.

visible.a: Your profile is private by default. Only when you share it can other signed-in students see your first name, your school and the details you choose. Your grade, email address and individual event registrations are never public.

privacy.a: Under “Profile sharing” you decide what is shared and can switch back to private at any time. In the chat, only members of a room can read its messages; private chats are only visible to the two people in them.

appearance.intro: Choose your accent colour for buttons, links and highlights. The background and status colours stay the same.
